title: The thesis finish date
hook: Two stated cases: explore the planned duration as the overrun denominator.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the planned duration as the overrun denominator affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Overrun, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the planned duration as the overrun denominator in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
